title: 第19章 演武场大发神威第20章 真有人往刀口上撞
content_zh:
纯小白这才发现，自己身上不知何时披了一件雪白的道袍，触手生温，还带着一股淡淡的檀香。
“你妹的，本大王就说怎么睡的不省人事，竟然还有人给盖被子？”
不过，他随即意识到，这下麻烦大了。
自己身上半点灵力都没有，骗骗这些炼气、筑基的小年轻还行，可这种活了几百年、杀人如麻的大佬，怎么可能看不穿？
“顾长老呢？”
“他在演武场，亲自指点弟子们剑势，大家都过去了。”
纯小白扫视一眼，发现偌大的传功堂，就只剩下他跟白锦儿，还有像门神一样杵在一旁的方元。
“快！快走！”
纯小白，心里直骂娘。
真是应了那句老话：一睡误终身呐！
……
此刻，演武场上，剑气纵横，正有两名弟子在切磋剑势。
顾长风负手而立，站在人群前方，目光如炬。
青云宗的外门弟子，无论是否修剑，都愿意来听顾长风传道。
正因为他传道的方式与其他长老不同。
别人最多讲解一下功法上的晦涩要点，你能不能学会全看自己的悟性。
而顾长风却不一样，只要你想学，他便知无不言，言无不尽，甚至会耐心地亲自下场，手把手指点每一个弟子剑法中的问题。
“顾长老！”
顾长风听到声音，侧过头，便看到了那个在自己课上呼呼大睡的家伙。
“您的衣服。”纯小白赶紧将道袍递了上去，刚准备转身就溜之大吉。

“你来的正好。”顾长老忽然开口，声音不大，却让纯小白的脚像是灌了铅一样。
“上去试试，让我看看你的剑势，到哪一步了。”
“完犊子了！”
纯小白心里一万头草泥马奔腾而过。
这尼玛的顾长老不会也是穿越者吧？
怎么跟上辈子那些大学教授一个德行？
凡是上课打瞌的学生，必叫起来回答问题！
不等他找借口推辞，身旁一位热心的弟子就好心地递来一把不知什么品质的长剑。
纯小白只能硬着头皮接下。
剑意不会，祖传刀法倒是练了十几年。
“纯师兄加油！”白锦儿还在一旁，像个小迷妹一样，挥舞着粉拳为他鼓掌。
content_en:
Only then did Chun Xiaobai realize that he had been wearing a snow-white Taoist robe at some point, which was warm to the touch and had a faint scent of sandalwood.
"Damn it, why did I, the king, sleep so unconsciously that there was someone covering you with a quilt?"
However, he soon realized that he was in big trouble.
I don't have any spiritual power in my body, so it's okay to deceive these young people who are refining Qi and building foundations, but how can such a big boss who has lived for hundreds of years and killed many people not see through this?
"Where's Elder Gu?"
"He was in the martial arts arena, personally teaching his disciples their sword skills, and everyone passed by."
Chun Xiaobai glanced around and found that only he, Bai Jin'er, and Fang Yuan stood aside like a door god in the huge transfer hall.
"Quick! Let's go!"
I am a pure novice, and I am cursing my mother in my heart.
It’s true to the old saying: a night of sleep is a waste of time!
…
At this moment, the martial arts arena was filled with sword aura, and two disciples were competing with each other on their sword skills.
Gu Changfeng stood in front of the crowd with his hands clasped behind his back, his eyes burning brightly.
The outer disciples of Qingyun Sect, regardless of whether they practice swordsmanship or not, are willing to listen to Gu Changfeng's teachings.
It is precisely because his way of preaching is different from other elders.
Others will at most explain the obscure key points of the exercises. Whether you can learn it all depends on your own understanding.
But Gu Changfeng is different. As long as you want to learn, he will tell you everything, and he will even patiently point out the problems in the swordsmanship of each disciple.
"Elder Gu!"
When Gu Changfeng heard the sound, he turned his head and saw the guy who was fast asleep in his class.
"Your clothes." Chun Xiaobai quickly handed over the Taoist robe and ran away just as he was about to turn around.
"You came just in time." Elder Gu suddenly spoke, his voice was not loud, but it made Chun Xiaobai's feet feel like they were filled with lead.
"Go up and try it. Let me see how far your sword power is."
"It's over!"
In Chun Xiaobai's heart, ten thousand grass and mud horses galloped past.
Isn’t this damn Elder Gu also a time traveler?
How can I be as virtuous as those university professors in my previous life?
Any student who dozes off in class will be called upon to answer questions!
Before he could find an excuse to refuse, an enthusiastic disciple next to him kindly handed over a long sword of unknown quality.
Pure newbie can only take it bravely.
He doesn't know how to use swordsmanship, but he has been practicing the ancestral sword skills for more than ten years.
"Brother Chun, come on!" Bai Jin'er was still standing aside, like a little fangirl, waving her pink fists and applauding him.
